Exhibit 2(a) provides evidence of land separately allotted to Ram Saran; it does not independently specify Imrit's entire partitioned portion.
Exhibit 2(b) is a statement made by Imrit. Its recorded content must be distinguished from its admissibility, credibility and the Court's subsequent evaluation of historical truth.
The Supreme Court admitted the connected statements in Exhibit 2(b) under section 32(3) of the Indian Evidence Act. It did not adopt section 32(7) as an established alternative basis.
